nodes.title: Mass growth allowance by maturity
nodes.text: Growth added to each item's basic mass by how it was obtained: EST 20 %, CALC 10 %, DATASHEET 5 %, CAD 5 %, WEIGHED 1 %. An item may override. The pack carries 0 %: its listing spread is not growth but a bounding case, reported separately at 546 / 551 / 590 g (ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE, ASM-A3-PACK-NOMINAL, D-64).
nodes.basis: Maturity-based allowance after AIAA S-120A (mass properties control); percentages are A3's choice for a student foam build, ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Total U-spacer stack behind the pack
nodes.text: Printed U-spacers POD-008 2/4/6/8/8 mm (0-28 mm) between the pack aft face and the aft stop. The aft travel from the nominal station is P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m (no spacer, D-59: 12 mm; D-62 aft stop 0.050 for the 135 mm pack); the forward travel is that minus this stack, further limited by the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK)
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-47 (spacer set 2/4/6/8/8), D-59 and D-62; replace by subsystems/pod/params.json spacer_set_m once D2 publishes it

nodes.title: Flight-pack mass bounds (D-64)
nodes.text: Lightest and heaviest flight pack the CG, gate and load cases run with: the Ovonic 120C EC5 listing minimum 546 g (551 - 5) and the D-64 acceptance line 590 g (T-E2-WEIGH pass line). The 503 / 680 g listings of the generic 4S 6500 search are retired as flight cases. CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT (the heaviest pack the first-build overrun still covers on this roll-up) must stay >= the upper bound; CL-A3-GATE-MARGIN-590 checks it
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-64 (E2 CR-E2-24/-25, A1 ASM-A1-PACK-CASES-G [546, 590]); weigh each pack on arrival

nodes.title: Flight-pack listed mass (D-64)
nodes.text: Ovonic 4S 6500 mAh 120C hard case EC5: listed 551 g (+/- 5 g); the parts.csv line carries 550 g (battery.mass_kg). The middle CG / gate case runs at the listed 551 g

nodes.title: Length from the pod nose to the most forward pack fore face
nodes.text: D-62 bay: pod nose -0.140 to the forward-stop aft face -0.1312 (8.8 mm: nose wall, nose block, 3 mm stop) + XPS F-250 crush block >= 24.3 mm + 1.5 mm PETG spreader = 34.6 mm; most forward pack fore face -0.1054, so the 135 mm pack centroid is >= -0.0379
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-62 (forward stop -0.1312, nose -0.140; was -0.1212 / -0.130 at D-47), CR-A1-43, crush block >= 24.3 mm C5 CR-C5-02, spreader 1.5 mm

nodes.title: Per-pack flight station rule (D-59)
nodes.text: Each weighed pack flies at the whole spacer step (P:pod.pack_spacer_step_m), counted forward from the no-spacer station (nominal + P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m), that puts the basic CG nearest cg.x_target_m, never ahead of the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK). Basic and predicted CG are both checked against the range
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-59 (A1-R4a), CR-A1-53; same rule as A1's CALC-A1-PACK-CASES

nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; margin(pack m) = gate - (predicted - m_pack,carried + m) ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s ; accept = m_pack,carried + margin - overrun

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le - nose_stack ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group ; trim(pack m) = slide that brings x_cg(m) into range

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG

nodes.title: Group masses, centroids and own inertias for the loads model (CR-C1-33)
nodes.equation: per group g (and per station within g): m_g = sum m_i ; r_g = sum m_i r_i / m_g ; I_g = sum m_i (|r_i - r_g|^2 E - (r_i - r_g)(r_i - r_g)^T) + boxes ; closure: sum_g [I_g + m_g (|d_g|^2 E - d_g d_g^T)] = I_aircraft, d_g = r_g - r_cg
